intent: Generic capability-based restoration of quiet fan configuration entities and physical managed-climate status after Home Assistant startup. Three separate physical native controllers reported fan_modes low/medium/high while their quiet switches and mode select were unavailable. Keep all supported device types; never add brand-specific code or fake fan modes.
note: Home Assistant source entities may announce fan_modes after Manager's Select/Switch platform has created its initial entities; also preserve previously registered controls while native source is missing. Register source-dependent controls when the real capabilities appear and refresh physical facade availability from exact native source events.
changes: Recreate previously registered quiet_sleep, quiet_occupied and quiet_fan_mode controls with stable unique IDs if the physical source has not yet advertised capabilities.
Dynamically add quiet fan configuration entities when a selected physical climate/fan/humidifier source later advertises supported fan modes.
Keep fan controls capability-gated; percentage fans never gain a fictional discrete fan mode dropdown; unsupported equipment never gets an invented Low option.
Watch only exact native entity state changes to refresh existing quiet controls and managed-climate availability without an all-entity dispatcher broadcast.
Never alter physical source integration entities, device permissions, hardware power control, or stored user settings.
Include Python 3.13/3.14 regression tests and installed HA 2026.10 late-start capability validation plus 38-language, frontend, HACS/Hassfest, flat release validation.
Preserve one canonical environment_manager domain, beta32 event-loop safety, and beta31 room/PID value repairs.
